findings.requirement: Promotion must independently validate each aggregate member as a complete, schema-valid, receipt-bound review or audit artifact before authorization.
findings.evidence: scripts/mros/advance_program.py:40-49 only checks that each aggregate item is a dict with matching candidate_head and non-empty execution_job_id/execution_role_id. It does not validate item sprint/round, verdict, findings, severity-count consistency, evidence_refs, transport, authority, independence booleans, packet/output paths, or bridge receipt binding. A fabricated PASS aggregate with one minimal item and positive mutually equal counts passes _validate_aggregate.
findings.falsifier: A deterministic test or implementation trace showing that _validate_aggregate rejects a minimal item lacking required review/audit schema fields and receipt/provenance validation would falsify this finding.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Revalidate every aggregate member with the canonical review/audit validators, exact S003/R003 binding, frozen-population membership, bridge receipt validation, and complete severity/count/provenance reconciliation before authorize can advance.
